selected.prompt: Single isolated game reward emblem, no text, no letters, no numbers. A polished brass drafting compass crossed with a short indigo-blue pencil over a warm ivory layered-paper medallion, one violet ink registration arc, strong geometric silhouette, restrained highlights and paper fibers. Front-facing handcrafted 2.5D editorial cartoon asset for a classic logic puzzle, readable at 96 pixels, transparent background, ample padding. No UI panel, no grid, no typography, no photorealistic desk.
selected.critique: The brass compass and crossed indigo pencils preserve a compact, legible drafting identity at runtime scale.

rejected.reason: Fine folded-paper details fragmented at runtime scale and several flourishes resembled unwanted glyphs.

audio_generation.prompt: A precise graphite pencil tick and polished brass drafting compass stamp on warm paper, followed by a restrained ascending two-note glass chime. Elegant classic logic puzzle completion reward, clean and dry, short, no voice, no music bed, no ambience, no cartoon explosion.

rejected_variation.reason: A conspicuous middle gap split the drafting impact from its reward tail.

selected_variation.critique: Compact pencil/metal transients lead immediately into a continuous restrained tail.
